quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics MOPS material information: release 1303-20260908-1 (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: driven by the AI wave, demand for mid- to high-end electronic materials is growing very fast; ultra-high-speed transmission and very low loss requirements have sharply raised the layer count, precision and process complexity of circuit boards, CCL and related materials, slowing production and limiting output, so supply is extremely tight; equipment supply is also short and needs several years to work through orders, so supply-chain capacity expansion is far slower than demand growth, and the industry broadly believes the supply-demand gap is still widening. The electronic-materials shortage has spread quickly from high-end to mid-range and basic materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics MOPS material information: release 1303-20260908-1 (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CCL and glass fabric (yarn) capacity is near full load and selling prices keep being raised steadily, with the sales share of mid- to high-end products rising; the company raised prices of CCL, copper foil and glass fabric (yarn) for mid-range and standard materials as well as high-end ones. With lines fully loaded, process optimisation broke through capacity bottlenecks, raising output in the short term, and will further lift high-end product output and sales in the next stage; certification and volume production of high-end materials are gradually showing results. August electronic materials revenue rose NT$8.8 hundred million from July (volume +1.1, price +7.7).
quarterly_data.figure: electronic materials revenue +NT$8.8 hundred million MoM (volume +1.1, price +7.7)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics MOPS material information: release 1303-20260908-1 (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: Nan Ya has built glass fabric (yarn), copper foil, epoxy resin, copper clad laminate and circuit board businesses since the 1980s, covering upstream, midstream and downstream circuit-board materials, with vertical-integration advantages in raw-material control and joint development; electronic materials revenue rose NT$82.6 hundred million year over year (volume +39.1, price +43.5) as AI demand drives a structural shift and rapid material upgrades.
